subject: How area is incorporated in spatial poisson models?

messages.author: 863a0481c01d0ecd
messages.subject: How area is incorporated in spatial poisson models?
parts:
Hello,

I am working on a poisson distributed model predicting the number of occurrences in different administrative districts. I am trying to find the best way to account for the effect of the area of each district in the model. 

I have followed the examples provided by Martino and Rue 2010 on oral cavity and larynx cancer mortality or the ones by Blangiardo et al 2013 on suicides in London or low birth rate in Georgia but cannot see how area of different administrative units was taken into account. Could anyone explain me why area is not considered or whether it is somehow implicitly incorporated in the models?

Thanks for any pointer.

Victor.
